description: Reviews skills-check-updates (scu) runs that change installed agent skills. --upgrade reinstalls skills listed in skills-lock.json from their GitHub sources through the skills CLI, rewrites the skill folders under .agents/skills and .claude/skills and updates skills-lock.json; --force overwrites local edits instead of merging them. Read-only reports and direct runs with --help, -h, --version or -v are not matched (launcher forms stay in review). Covers the scu and skills-check-updates executables and npx, bunx, pnpx, pnpm, yarn, npm exec, npm x, bun x, pnpm dlx and yarn dlx launches, including versioned launches (skills-check-updates@tag).
name: skills-check-updates command protection
saferAlternatives: Run scu without --upgrade first: it only reports which skills changed upstream.
Run scu --upgrade without --force: it merges local edits with upstream changes and skips skills whose changes overlap.
